text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Classic Triple 
Crown. The day of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"We've finally made it. To this grand 
autumn stage."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it~, Trainer-san, have 
you ever heard a story like this?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I hear there's a specific jinx associated 
with each of the three Classic races."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In the Satsuki Sho, the 'fastest' 
Umamusume shines. In the Derby, the 
'luckiest' Umamusume shines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"And in the Kikuka Sho... it's the 
'strongest' Umamusume who shines."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I came to this place to show my strength. 
That's how I think of it♪
choice_data_list:
Yeah, when it comes to sheer ability, 
you're number one!

Yeah, in terms of sheer ability, they're 
number one!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What I consider strength and what you 
consider strength might be a little 
different, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, the strength I believe in is—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "The strength of my bond with Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"We didn't choose each other based on 
talent or calculation."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Staying true to my feelings... I chose 
the person I want to be beside the most."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That is why, through all that pain... she 
was able to make such a magnificent 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Our bond is truly wonderful and 
irreplaceable. That is why...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm going to show everyone what I can do♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Please wait for me at the goal with 
open arms, my Trainer.

"Something burst wide open. With her 
shackles off, Super Creek will surely pull 
it off!"
